summary: Faunce tower in Lake of the Woods County, a 100-foot stairway tower built by the CCC in 1935 that replaced an older tower about three miles south; the directory lists it standing.

notes_for_editor: The 1935 CCC build date, the 100-foot stairway and the older tower about three miles south all come from one local tourism page; no DNR, NRHP or other tower record was read. The directory row 'Faunce – first' (48.55044, -94.95354, Tower Gone) sits about three miles south of the current tower, which fits the older-tower account, but the link is our inference. The Norris Camp National Register nomination appeared in search results but was not read. The Commons photo for Faunce is already in data/photos_manifest.json, so no photos entry was added. The 30.5 m height is a conversion of the guide's 100-foot figure.
